usedFor: Todoist is where tasks are captured and Desklog.io tracks the time, so “New Task Created in Project” runs “Create Task”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Task Created in Project” in Todoist, then “Create Task” in Desklog.io
bestTemplate.why: Tasks added in a chosen Todoist project show up in Desklog.io, ready for time tracking.

watchOut: “New Incomplete Task” only looks at recently added tasks, so older ones can be missed.
